summary: Phases 1-6 complete and green: find_countermodel raises OracleTimeoutError instead of conflating timeout with UNSAT; CLI, interface/provider tests, differential harness, and 5 xfail tests all migrated. Phase 7 full-suite run: scan-alone shows disagreements=0 (core fix works) but conclusive=106/274 misses the 137 floor (undersized calibration sample). Full oracle-suite FAILED both passes: the floor miss plus 5 pre-existing test_soundness_regression.py failures (same root-cause bug, file outside this plan's scope). Reported honestly, not forced green.

blockers.description: MIN_CONCLUSIVE_SCAN_FORMULAS=137 calibrated from a 30-formula sample that only reached complexity 4; the real 274-formula sweep measured 106 conclusive (38.7%). Needs recalibration from this real data, then oracle/run-oracle-suite.sh re-run to confirm green.

5 tests in oracle/bimodal_logic/tests/test_soundness_regression.py (never touched by this plan) fail with OracleTimeoutError at temporal_depth=2/M=4/5000ms -- the same timeout/UNSAT conflation bug, discovered in a third file outside this plan's inventory. Needs its own follow-up task applying the resolved-and-wrong/inconclusive pattern from Phases 3 and 6.

decisions_made: Kept SELF_SCAN_SOLVE_TIMEOUT_MS=10000 rather than escalating to the 20000 hard ceiling: measured conclusiveness was flat/noisy (53.3/50.0/56.7%) with no real gain, while 20000ms's extrapolated full-scan wall clock alone risks exceeding the 90-min abort ceiling.
Did not adjust the floor or re-run to force a green result; reported the actual measured counts per explicit coordinator instruction.
5 tests outside the plan's Bucket-1 inventory were found broken by the same cause in Phase 3 and fixed with the same classify-and-skip pattern (see plan/summary for detail).
dead_ends: Widening the solve budget past 10000ms buys no measured conclusiveness benefit on this oracle -- confirmed at 15000 and 20000ms.
